# Support

Medical Admission Pro is an independently maintained educational practice platform for students preparing for medical admission in Bangladesh.

## Where to get help

- **Website usage, account, exam, result or leaderboard questions:** open a [Support question](https://github.com/serakib/Medical-Admission-Tracker/issues/new/choose) and choose the most relevant available issue form. If no suitable form is available, use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/serakib/Medical-Admission-Tracker/discussions) if enabled, or contact the maintainer through their [GitHub profile](https://github.com/serakib).
- **Reproducible software bug:** use the [Bug Report form](https://github.com/serakib/Medical-Admission-Tracker/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Feature idea:** use the [Feature Request form](https://github.com/serakib/Medical-Admission-Tracker/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Accessibility barrier:** use the [Accessibility Report form](https://github.com/serakib/Medical-Admission-Tracker/issues/new?template=accessibility_report.yml).
- **Security vulnerability:** do not create a public issue. Follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) and use private reporting where available.

## What to include

Describe what you were trying to do, what happened, what you expected, and the browser/device involved. Include screenshots only after removing email addresses, student information, tokens and other private details.

Never post passwords, verification codes, session tokens, private student records or production credentials.

## Support scope

This is a maintainer-led project, not a paid support service. There is no guaranteed response time or uptime commitment. Please be respectful and allow time for review.
